rule_objections: Rule is narrow but fine for JSON Schema; however the third file (haijun-code-marketplace.json) is a draft-07 schema that names nothing under root $defs/definitions (all structure is inline `properties`), so the rule yields nothing for it - a developer looking up its sub-schemas gets only `configuration` keys. Rule does not cover `properties` names at all, so a schema with no definitions is invisible except through generic key symbols.
Two of the three largest files are the same schema in two versions (2.0.3, 2.2.0), so effective sample is two schemas.
findings: Grammar-rule symbols exactly right: 46 expected (23 + 23 `definitions` entries), 46 found as type_alias, same names and lines (verified by script against the JSON key lines); 0 spurious, 0 missed; haijun correctly yields 0.

Separate analyser (not counted against the rule): 372 + 372 + 357 `configuration` symbols for these three files (one per key), i.e. 1101 config symbols vs 46 schema definitions; every file's total symbol count is 395 / 395 / 357.
Text search works: `search marketplace` finds haijun-code-marketplace.json; `search pageObjectInterface` finds both utam files.
not_done: Not tested: OpenAPI components.schemas, $defs (Draft 2019+), escaped schema names.
